<!--歌单详情页，先获取数据，在渲染页面-->
<template>
    <TheTop :playlist="state.playlist"></TheTop>
</template>
<script setup>
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router';//this.$route
import { onMounted,reactive } from 'vue';
import {getSongSheet}from '@/request/API/SongSheet'
import  TheTop  from '@/components/SongSheet/TheTop.vue'//引入组件不加括号
const state=reactive({
    playlist:{}
});
onMounted(async()=>{
 let id=useRoute().query.id;
 let res =await getSongSheet(id);

 state.playlist=res.data.playlist;
 console.log(state.playlist)
 console.log(state.playlist.description)

})
</script>
